svg.title: vLLM mixed steps versus SGLang prefill-first batches
svg.desc: In vLLM V1 every step can hold decode tokens of A and B and prefill tokens of C. In SGLang by default a forward is either an EXTEND batch or a DECODE batch. When C arrives, batch 1 is an EXTEND batch with only C, and A and B wait one forward. From batch 2 all three decode together.
svg.text: vLLM V1 · one step mixes prefill and decode
SGLang default · EXTEND batch first, otherwise DECODE
A AND B SKIP ONE DECODE WHILE C PREFILLS · --ENABLE-MIXED-CHUNK MERGES THEM
